title: Nasib Indovision Sekarang
article:
JAKARTA, investor.id – Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) meminta penjelasan terkait kondisi PT MNC Sky Vision Tbk (MSKY) terkini.

Sebagai informasi, dalam keterangan resmi Desember 2025 lalu, MNC Sky Vision mengumumkan transisi besar. Di mana perseroan mengakhiri penggunaan satelit lamanya dan berpindah ke satelit baru di bawah brand legendaris yang kembali dihidupkan, yakni Indovision.

Sebelumnya, nama Indovision dilakukan rebranding menjadi MNC Vision pada 2017 silam. Dan kemudian diubah lagi menjadi Indovision sejak akhir tahun 2025.

Dalam keterbukaan informasi pada Rabu (18/11/2026), manajemen MSKY menjelaskan, sampai dengan 30 September 2026, perseroan mencatat jumlah pelanggan aktif sebanyak 36.742 pelanggan, dengan jumlah pelanggan baru sebanyak 5.000 pelanggan, tingkat pelanggan yang berhenti berlangganan (churn rate) sebesar 2%, serta rata-rata pendapatan per pelanggan (ARPU) sebesar Rp 59.000.

Adapun sepanjang sembilan bulan 2026 (9M2026), MSKY membukukan pendapatan Rp 166,83 miliar, anjlok dari Rp 302,1 miliar pada periode yang sama tahun 2025.

Sedangkan dari sisi bottom line, perseroan mengalami rugi bersih yang diatribusikan kepada pemilik entitas induk Rp 113,68 miliar. Angkanya berkurang dari Rp 196,03 miliar pada 9M2025.

Jumlah liabilitas per akhir September 2026 sebanyak Rp 542,28 miliar.

Menurut manajemen MSKY, terjadi semakin ketatnya persaingan di industri hiburan, khususnya dengan berkembangnya layanan over-the-top (OTT) yang menawarkan beragam pilihan konten serta kemudahan akses bagi masyarakat.

Selain itu, muncul peningkatan ketersediaan konten hiburan gratis melalui berbagai platform digital, seperti You Tube, Facebook, dan TikTok, yang turut memengaruhi minat dan preferensi masyarakat terhadap layanan televisi berlangganan.

Kondisi pun ditambah dengan perekonomian dan daya beli masyarakat yang turut memengaruhi pola konsumsi serta alokasi pengeluaran rumah tangga, termasuk untuk kebutuhan hiburan dan layanan televisi berlangganan.

Sebelumnya, MNC Sky Vision mengungkap perseroan telah menerima putusan Pengadilan Niaga pada Pengadilan Negeri Jakarta Pusat atas permohonan penundaan kewajiban pembayaran utang (PKPU) yang diajukan oleh Ascot Group Holdings Ltd terhadap perseroan dengan Nomor Perkara 292/Pdt.Sus-PKPU/2026/PN Niaga Jkt.Pst., tertanggal 5 November 2026.

Berdasarkan putusan tersebut, pengadilan telah mengabulkan permohonan PKPU dan menyatakan perseroan berada dalam keadaan PKPU Sementara selama 43 hari terhitung sejak tanggal putusan diucapkan, yaitu sampai dengan tanggal 17 Desember 2026.

title: Emiten Portofolio Andry Hakim Ambil Keputusan Krusial
article:
JAKARTA, investor.id – Emiten portofolio Andry Hakim, PT Falmaco Nonwoven Industri Tbk (FLMC) dijadwalkan menggelar rapat umum pemegang saham luar biasa (RUPSLB) pada Rabu (18/11/2026) ini mulai pukul 10.00 WIB di Bandung.

FLMC akan mengambil keputusan krusial dalam rapat ini yang mencakup tiga mata acara.

Pertama, penyesuaian KBLI pada anggaran dasar perseroan menjadi KBLI tahun 2025 yang dikeluarkan Badan Pusat Statistik berdasarkan Peraturan BPS Nomor 7 Tahun 2025.

Kedua, penambahan KBLI 64210 aktivitas perusahaan induk, sehubungan rencana perseroan untuk mendirikan anak usaha di kemudian hari.

Ketiga, perubahan tempat kedudukan perseroan.

PT Falmaco Nonwoven Industri Tbk (FLMC) berencana melakukan perubahan kegiatan usaha menjadi perusahaan induk, yakni KBLI 64210.

“Dalam rangka memperkuat rantai pasok, memperluas jaringan pemasaran, dan meningkatkan daya saing kelompok usaha, perseroan berencana membentuk suatu anak perusahaan yang bergerak di bidang perdagangan dan distribusi yang berfokus pada produk perseroan,” ungkap manajemen FLMC dalam keterbukaan informasi dikutip Selasa (17/11/2026).

Berdasarkan business plan, kata manajemen FLMC, anak usaha distribusi diproyeksikan mulai beroperasi pada tahun 2027 dengan pendapatan sebesar Rp 70 miliar. Pendapatan tersebut diproyeksikan meningkat menjadi Rp 78,40 miliar pada 2028, Rp 87,81 miliar pada 2029, dan Rp 98,34 miliar pada 2030.

Pola proyeksi tersebut mencerminkan pertumbuhan sekitar 12% per tahun selama periode 2027–2030. Proyeksi tersebut menunjukkan bahwa manajemen menempatkan anak usaha distribusi sebagai salah satu penggerak utama pertumbuhan pendapatan grup.

Dalam proyeksi konsolidasian, total pendapatan grup meningkat dari sekitar Rp 105,60 miliar pada 2027 menjadi sekitar Rp 145,41 miliar pada 2030, dengan kontribusi terbesar berasal dari anak usaha distribusi. Dengan demikian, keberhasilan realisasi proyeksi sangat bergantung pada kemampuan anak usaha mencapai target volume penjualan, menjaga margin, mengendalikan biaya logistik, serta memastikan kolektibilitas piutang.

title: VIVA dan MDIA Perkuat Bisnis Penyiaran dan Digital
article:
JAKARTA, investor.id – PT Visi Media Asia Tbk (VIVA) dan PT Intermedia Capital Tbk (MDIA) berhasil menjaga kinerja operasional melalui efisiensi biaya dan pengembangan bisnis penyiaran serta digital.

Dalam Public Expose, VIVA membukukan pendapatan Rp441,44 miliar dan EBITDA Rp30,68 miliar. Margin EBITDA bertahan pada 6,9%, sama dengan periode tahun sebelumnya, meski pendapatan turun 7,6%. Laba bersih tercatat Rp60,02 miliar, dibandingkan Rp1,19 triliun pada semester I 2025.

Tanpa memperhitungkan rencana konversi, posisi keuangan VIVA juga menunjukkan peningkatan ekuitas 37,2% menjadi Rp496,10 miliar pada akhir Juni 2026 dibandingkan akhir Desember 2025. Total liabilitas turun 3,0% menjadi Rp5,84 triliun. Di sisi lain, MDIA membukukan EBITDA positif Rp59,71 miliar dengan margin 21,2% pada semester I 2026. Total liabilitas turun 17,1% menjadi Rp1,99 triliun dibandingkan akhir 2025. Pendapatan tercatat Rp281,82 miliar, turun 8,6% dibandingkan semester I 2025, dengan rugi bersih Rp32,30 miliar dari sebelumnya Rp11,44 miliar.

Sebelum pelaksanaan Public Expose, RUPST VIVA dan MDIA telah menerima laporan kinerja usaha dan keuangan masing-masing Perseroan untuk tahun buku 2025. Selain itu, pemegang saham VIVA juga menyetujui pengangkatan kembali Ilham Akbar Habibie sebagai Wakil Presiden Komisaris merangkap Komisaris Independen, Arief Yahya sebagai Presiden Direktur, dan Jastiro Abi sebagai Wakil Presiden Direktur VIVA untuk periode 5 tahun mendatang.

Melalui ANTV, MDIA memperkuat bisnis penyiaran dengan mengandalkan loyalitas pemirsa serta strategi pengembangan konten lokal dan asing. Berdasarkan data Nielsen Januari–Oktober 2026, ANTV menempati peringkat keenam pada pengukuran National Urban Terrestrial untuk pemirsa usia lima tahun ke atas, dengan audience share 6,4%.

Kekuatan ANTV juga terlihat pada segmen perempuan usia 25 tahun ke atas, dengan menempati peringkat ketiga di wilayah non-Jawa dengan share 9,2% serta peringkat kedua di Bali dan Nusa Tenggara dengan share 12,3%. Salah satu program unggulan ANTV Mega Bollywood bahkan memimpin slot tayang pukul 09.30–13.00 pada segmen ibu rumah tangga di wilayah non-Jawa, dengan share 11,4%. Untuk menjaga engagement pemirsa sekaligus memperkaya pilihan tayangan, ANTV terus melengkapi program asing dengan drama lokal dan film Indonesia.

Sejak September 2026, ANTV kembali menghadirkan drama lokal pada jam tayang utama, termasuk Jodoh Wasiat Bapak Reborn dan Alas Roban The Series. Pengembangan konten melalui strategi berbagi biaya dengan platform over-the-top (OTT) ini mendukung ANTV dalam penyediaan konten premium sekaligus menjaga efisiensi biaya produksi. Di luar layar televisi, ANTV memperluas interaksi dengan pemirsa melalui Festival ANTV Rame, kegiatan hiburan off-air di berbagai kota yang dipadukan dengan siaran televisi dan kanal digital.

Sepanjang Januari–Oktober 2026, kanal digital ANTV mencatatkan 564 juta penayangan YouTube dan 217 juta unique visitor atau naik 33%. Sementara itu, tvOne terus memperkuat posisinya sebagai saluran TV berita utama pada segmen laki-laki dan perempuan usia 20 tahun ke atas kelas sosial ekonomi Upper 1.

Berdasarkan pengukuran Nielsen National Urban Terrestrial untuk seluruh program berita pada Januari– Oktober 2026, tvOne meraih audience share 4,7% dan memimpin di antara saluran TV berita pada segmen tersebut. Pada segmen yang sama, program berita Kabar Pagi mencatatkan share 6,6%, sedangkan Kabar Petang dan Apa Kabar Indonesia Pagi masing-masing 6,8%.

“Capaian ini menjadi pijakan untuk menentukan prioritas usaha. Bagi kami, tantangannya adalah menerjemahkan loyalitas pemirsa menjadi peluang pendapatan yang berkelanjutan,” ujar Wakil Presiden Direktur VIVA, Jastiro Abi. Kombinasi kekuatan ANTV di segmen hiburan keluarga dan tvOne pada segmen berita memberi keunggulan tersendiri bagi bisnis penyiaran Grup VIVA dalam menjangkau beragam segmen pemirsa dan memenuhi kebutuhan pengiklan. VIVA dan MDIA akan terus mengembangkan potensi kedua stasiun televisi melalui konten yang relevan, integrasi lintas platform, dan pengelolaan biaya yang efisien untuk memperkuat daya saing serta mendorong pertumbuhan bisnis.

title: From SpaceX to Saudi Aramco, the World's 10 Biggest IPOs
article:
Washington. Anthropic, the developer of the Claude artificial intelligence chatbot, is set to make its Wall Street debut on Thursday in an initial public offering (IPO) that could raise as much as $64.4 billion, potentially making it the second-largest stock market listing in history.

The offering would rank behind SpaceX, the rocket and artificial intelligence company, which raised US$75 billion in its Nasdaq listing in June 2026, nearly three times the previous record.

The following is a ranking of the 10 largest IPOs on record by funds raised, excluding additional shares that underwriters may purchase after the offering.
• SpaceX — $75 billion. The rocket and AI company listed on the Nasdaq in June 2026, setting a new record for the largest IPO in history.
• Saudi Aramco — $25.6 billion. The Saudi Arabian oil giant made its debut on the Riyadh stock exchange in December 2019.
• Alibaba — $21.8 billion. The Chinese e-commerce company was listed on the New York Stock Exchange in September 2014.
• SoftBank Corp. — $21.3 billion. The Japanese telecommunications company went public on the Tokyo Stock Exchange in December 2018.
• Agricultural Bank of China — $19.2 billion. The Chinese lender was listed simultaneously in Shanghai and Hong Kong in July 2010.
• Industrial and Commercial Bank of China — $19.1 billion. The Chinese bank made its debut on the Hong Kong and Shanghai stock exchanges in October 2006.
• NTT Mobile — $18.1 billion. The Japanese mobile operator was listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange in October 1998.
• Visa — $17.9 billion. The US credit card network made its debut on the New York Stock Exchange in March 2008.
• AIA Group — $17.8 billion. The Asian insurance business was formerly owned by US insurer AIG, listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in October 2010.
• Enel — $16.5 billion. The Italian energy company made its stock market debut in November 1999, with its shares trading in Milan and New York.

title: AKR Expands Fuel Empire With $15.5 Million Vivo Acquisition
article:
Jakarta. Indonesian fuel distributor AKR Corporindo is expanding its retail fuel business through a $15.5 million (Rp 281.96 billion) acquisition of Vivo Energy Indonesia and another company, with Vivo's fuel stations set to join the BP-AKR network once the transaction is completed.

Under a conditional sale and purchase agreement (CSPA), Aneka Petroindo Raya (APR), which operates BP-AKR fuel stations in Indonesia, and Petro Palma Persada (PPP) have agreed to acquire all shares in Vivo Energy Indonesia (VEI), the operator of Vivo fuel stations, and Nusantara Karya Orange (NKO).

AKR Corporindo President Director Haryanto Adikoesoemo said the sellers were Vitol Apac Energy Pte Ltd and Nusantara Energy Resources Pte Ltd for VEI; and Vitol Apac Energy Pte Ltd and Vitol Apac Commodities Pte Ltd for NKO.

The two companies are being acquired for a combined $15.5 million, representing 100% of their issued and fully paid-up shares, Haryanto said in a disclosure to the Indonesia Stock Exchange on Wednesday.

Following completion, APR will hold 90% of the shares in both VEI and NKO, while PPP will own the remaining 10%.

The transaction remains subject to the fulfillment of conditions precedent set out in the agreement.

Haryanto said the acquisition was intended to support the AKR group's fuel distribution business and ensure continuity of services for its retail fuel customers.

Following the deal's completion, all Vivo fuel stations operated by VEI will be integrated into the BP-AKR retail network.

The acquisition comes shortly after AKR moved to take full ownership of APR. On Nov. 6, AKR subsidiaries Anugerah Krida Retailindo (AKRIDA) and Andahanesa Abadi (ADH) acquired BP Global Investments Limited's 49.9% stake in APR for US$14.22 million, or around Rp257.8 billion.

Before that transaction, AKRIDA held 50.1% of APR, while BP owned the remaining 49.9%. The purchase brought APR entirely under the AKR group, following BP's decision to divest its stake as part of a strategy to simplify its portfolio.

APR operates the BP-AKR fuel retail business in Indonesia through its joint venture with AKR, which has now become wholly owned by the Indonesian group.

Market analyst Hendra Wardana, founder of Republik Investor, said the Vivo acquisition could strengthen AKR's position in the downstream oil and gas sector by expanding its fuel distribution and retail network.

He said acquiring an established network would allow the company to gain access to additional distribution infrastructure and an existing customer base without having to build stations from scratch, potentially saving time and investment.

The integration could also create economies of scale by increasing fuel sales volumes, expanding market coverage and improving efficiencies across procurement, storage, transportation and distribution, he said.

Beyond fuel retail, AKR's business portfolio includes basic chemical distribution, logistics services and the development of the Java Integrated Industrial and Port Estate (JIIPE), an integrated industrial and port zone in East Java.

AKR reported revenue of Rp46.53 trillion in the first nine months of 2026, up 43.6% from the same period last year. Net profit attributable to owners of the parent company rose around 34% to Rp2.21 trillion.

Wardana said the Vivo network could become an additional growth driver, although its contribution to earnings might take time to materialize as the companies adjust their operations following the integration.

He also cited demand for fuel and chemicals, along with the potential monetization of industrial land at JIIPE, as factors supporting AKR's business outlook.

title: Prabowo Secures $71.8 Billion Deals on China Visit
article:
Jakarta. Indonesia has bagged business deals worth up to $71.8 billion during President Prabowo Subianto’s visit to Shenzhen, according to a government statement.

Prabowo touched down in the Chinese metropolis around Wednesday afternoon local time for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) gathering. He kicked off the visit by witnessing the signing of some memoranda of understanding (MoUs) ahead of the closely watched meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping.

Kota Masa Depan Indonesia, backed by the sovereign fund Danantara, sealed a $50 billion deal with a Shaanxi-led consortium. The money will go into building 10 of the so-called “future smart cities”. Danantara boss Rosan Roeslani signaled that construction would likely begin “early next year”.

Chinese appliance powerhouse Hisense agreed to a $10 billion MoU that involves the Higher Education Ministry and Danantara. The investment revolves around joint research and development (R&D), talent development, as well as household goods manufacturing.

Danantara has partnered with China’s largest state-owned investment holding SDIC, in a $10 billion deal for “infrastructure financing”.

A coal-to-ethanol project is on the list. Under the $1.8 billion deal, the Higher Education Ministry, the state-run energy giant Pertamina, and Beijing Petrochemical Engineering are expected to work on technology transfers.

Danantara has yet to respond to the Jakarta Globe’s request to disclose more details.

Deepening economic ties appears to be high up on the agenda of Prabowo’s Shenzhen trip. MoUs aside, Prabowo and Xi are expected to begin talks on a bilateral free trade agreement amid Jakarta’s colossal deficit with Beijing.

Between January and September, Indonesia’s deficit with China swelled by almost 49% year-on-year to $21.2 billion. The combined investments from mainland China and Hong Kong totaled $17.8 billion over the same period, government data showed.

title: Franky Widjaja Steps Down From Sinar Mas Palm Oil Firm SMART
article:
Jakarta. Franky Oesman Widjaja has stepped down as president commissioner of palm oil producer Sinar Mas Agro Resources and Technology (IDX: SMAR), following an extraordinary shareholders meeting that appointed new members to the company's board of commissioners.

The resignation was approved at SMART's extraordinary general meeting of shareholders (EGMS) on Nov. 17, 2026, according to the meeting's summary of minutes filed with the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX).

The meeting approved the resignations of Franky as president commissioner, Rafael Buhay Concepcion Jr. as vice president commissioner, and Lukmono Sutarto as commissioner, effective upon the meeting's conclusion.

Shareholders also approved the appointment of David Fernando Audy as the new president commissioner and Dicky Bayu Atmadja as vice president commissioner. Both will serve the remainder of their predecessors' terms, until the close of the company's 2030 annual general meeting of shareholders.

Following the changes, SMART's board of commissioners comprises:

 1. David Fernando Audy as president commissioner

 2. Dicky Bayu Atmadja as vice president commissioner

 3. Prof. Dr. Teddy Pawitra as vice president commissioner and independent commissioner

 4. Prof. Dr. Susiyati B. Hirawan as independent commissione

 5. Ardhayadi Ketut Sanjaya as independent commissioner

Franky's departure from SMART follows his earlier resignation as president commissioner of another Sinar Mas Group-listed company, Dian Swastatika Sentosa (DSSA), in September 2026.

Franky is one of the sons of Sinar Mas founder Eka Tjipta Widjaja, who died in 2019. He has played a prominent role in the group's agribusiness operations, particularly through Golden Agri-Resources (GAR), the Singapore-listed parent company of SMART, where he serves as chairman and chief executive officer.

The Widjaja family ranked among Indonesia's wealthiest business families, with an estimated fortune of $18.9 billion in 2024, up 75% from $10.8 billion a year earlier, according to Forbes.

Forbes attributed the increase largely to a more than sevenfold surge in shares of DSSA, Sinar Mas' energy and infrastructure arm. Investor enthusiasm was supported by the company's expansion beyond coal into renewable energy and telecommunications, including plans to develop geothermal projects and a data center in Jakarta.

The family's estimated fortune climbed further to $28.3 billion in 2025, according to Forbes.

SMART operates approximately 137,000 hectares of oil palm plantations, including plasma estates. Its business spans the cultivation and harvesting of oil palm, processing fresh fruit bunches into crude palm oil (CPO) and palm kernel (PK), and refining these products into consumer and industrial goods, including cooking oil, margarine, shortening, biodiesel and oleochemicals.

The company operates 16 palm oil mills, four palm kernel processing plants, four refineries, two biodiesel plants and one oleochemical plant in Indonesia. Its consumer products include cooking oil brands Filma and Kunci Mas.

title: Citi Indonesia Reports Rp1.53 Trillion Profit in First Nine Months of 2026
article:
Jakarta. Citibank N.A. Indonesia (Citi Indonesia) reported a net profit of Rp1.53 trillion ($83.9 million) in the first nine months of 2026, supported by loan and deposit growth and stable asset quality.

The bank's loan portfolio reached Rp30.5 trillion as of September, up Rp3.6 trillion, or 13.2%, from the end of 2025. The expansion was driven by financing demand from corporate and institutional clients, including credit facilities and trade financing.

Citi Indonesia CEO Batara Sianturi said the bank recorded net interest income of Rp3.14 trillion during the January-September period.

On the funding side, deposits grew 10% to Rp66.2 trillion from the end of last year. Demand deposits, which account for the largest share of the bank's funding base, also increased 10% to Rp52.6 trillion.

The growth lifted the bank's current account and savings account (CASA) ratio to 79.57%, slightly above the 79.39% recorded at the end of 2025.

Batara said manufacturing, financial institutions, and agriculture accounted for around 80% of the bank's total loan portfolio, making them its three main lending sectors.

Despite the expansion, Citi Indonesia maintained an exceptionally low non-performing loan (NPL) ratio of 0.01%.

The bank's capital adequacy ratio (CAR) stood at 33.6%, while its liquidity coverage ratio (LCR) reached 246%.

“These capital and liquidity conditions serve as the foundation for the company to support customer needs while maintaining sustainable business growth,” said Batara.

For 2027, Citi Indonesia is targeting loan and deposit growth of 5% to 10%, equivalent to mid- to high-single-digit expansion.

The bank also sees opportunities to expand its financing and advisory services related to artificial intelligence (AI), particularly for data center developers, chip manufacturers and large-scale cloud computing infrastructure providers.

title: Jakarta Stocks Slide 1% as BI Delivers Rate Hike
article:
Jakarta. Jakarta stocks fell 57 points or 1.07% to 5,247 on Wednesday as investors weighed Bank Indonesia’s decision to raise its benchmark interest rate to 6% against mounting global uncertainty and concerns over further monetary tightening in the United States.

A total of 492 stocks declined, while 200 advanced and 253 remained unchanged. Trading value reached Rp 14.14 trillion ($775.24 million).

Bank Indonesia (BI) raised its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 6.00% on Wednesday, stepping up monetary tightening to stabilize the rupiah amid heightened global uncertainty.

BI Governor Destry Damayanti said the increase was intended to strengthen rupiah stability while taking preemptive measures to keep inflation within the central bank’s target range of 2.5% ± 1% for both 2026 and 2027.

“Bank Indonesia will consistently direct its monetary policy toward strengthening stability and keeping inflation within the target range,” Destry said at a press conference in Jakarta on Wednesday.

Pilarmas Investindo Sekuritas said both external and domestic factors weighed on the Jakarta Composite Index (JCI).

Externally, regional Asian markets traded mixed as expectations of further Federal Reserve rate hikes gained traction. St. Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem indicated that several rate increases might be necessary to bring inflation under control. New York Fed President John Williams also supported further monetary tightening to curb persistent inflation, although he cautioned against expectations of a more aggressive rate-hiking path.

Investors also remained cautious ahead of an anticipated trilateral meeting between Chinese President Xi Jinping, US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin on the sidelines of the APEC Summit, where the three leaders are expected to discuss key global issues.

The meeting comes as US-China tensions resurface following Washington’s tighter semiconductor export controls in Southeast Asia, which require licenses for advanced artificial intelligence chips from Nvidia Corp. and other US companies.

Meanwhile, oil prices remained stable as markets weighed escalating tensions in the Middle East against rising supply and increasing US oil inventories.

On the domestic front, BI’s November 17-18 Board of Governors Meeting (RDG) was a key focus for investors, particularly as rupiah weakness had become the central bank’s most pressing concern. Pressure on the currency was compounded by growing market expectations of another Fed rate hike in December, with the probability reaching 96%.

Across Asia, regional shares ended mixed on Wednesday as artificial intelligence stocks rebounded following widespread losses among technology companies on Wall Street.

South Korea’s Kospi advanced 1.9%, while Japan’s Nikkei gained 0.3%. Hong Kong’s Hang Seng Index fell 0.9%, while the Shanghai Composite edged up 0.1%.

title: BI Tightens Cybersecurity Safeguards for Indonesia's Payment Systems
article:
Jakarta. Bank Indonesia (BI) is strengthening cybersecurity safeguards across the country's payment systems through four measures aimed at preventing cyberattacks, minimizing transaction disruptions, and maintaining public confidence in digital financial services.

Deputy Governor Filianingsih Hendarta said on Wednesday that the central bank was monitoring cyber threats and incidents in Indonesia and overseas, particularly those targeting financial institutions and potentially affecting the security and smooth operation of national payment systems.

The measures include tighter cybersecurity oversight of payment service providers, stronger coordination with government agencies and industry stakeholders, and improved incident reporting and recovery capabilities.

“We continue to monitor cyber threats and incidents occurring both domestically and globally in the financial sector and assess their potential impact on the security and smooth operation of the national payment system,” Filianingsih said at a press conference following BI's Board of Governors Meeting in Jakarta.

Under the second measure, BI is tightening regulations and supervision of cybersecurity among payment system operators. The oversight covers risk management, protection of critical infrastructure, early threat detection, and preparedness to respond to cyber incidents.

Filianingsih said service providers must also ensure they can restore operations quickly in the event of an attack to prevent disruptions from lasting too long.

The third measure involves closer coordination with the National Cyber and Crypto Agency (BSSN), the Financial Services Authority (OJK), industry associations, and relevant ministries and government agencies to prevent, monitor, and respond to cyber incidents that could disrupt the national payment system.

The fourth measure requires payment service providers, including supporting service companies, to strengthen security measures and improve their ability to detect suspicious transactions. They must also report cyber incidents promptly to BI and relevant authorities.

“Should an incident occur, it must be reported promptly to Bank Indonesia and the relevant authorities so that we can work together to address it,” Filianingsih said.

BI also urged the public to remain vigilant by safeguarding personal information and access to financial transactions, avoiding the circulation of unverified information about cyberattacks and checking developments through official channels.

The central bank's measures come amid a series of cyber incidents affecting financial institutions internationally.

French lender Credit Mutuel Arkea said last week that hackers had stolen around €100 million ($112.61 million), prompting the bank to seek recovery of the funds. French prosecutors have opened an investigation into the incident, which was reported earlier this month.

Financial institutions in Japan, Taiwan, and Malaysia have also faced cybersecurity incidents involving unauthorized access to customer accounts, data theft, and financial fraud.

Indonesia has also faced a high volume of cyberthreat activity. FortiGuard Labs recorded around 1.6 million cyberthreat activities blocked over a 24-hour period as of Nov. 9, equivalent to approximately 19 detections per second.

Cybersecurity expert Alfons Tanujaya cautioned, however, that the figure did not necessarily indicate an extraordinary surge in attacks or successful breaches. Much of the activity involved automated scanning by botnets and other software searching for system vulnerabilities.

title: Foreign Investors Pull $900 Million From Indonesian Stocks Amid Global Uncertainty
article:
Jakarta. Foreign investors withdrew $900 million from Indonesia’s stock market in the fourth quarter through Nov. 16, as persistent global economic uncertainty and shifting investor sentiment weighed on domestic equities, Bank Indonesia (BI) said on Wednesday.

Despite the equity market outflows, Indonesia recorded overall net foreign portfolio inflows of $4.8 billion during the same period, supported by strong capital inflows into government debt securities.

Bank Indonesia Governor Destry Damayanti said foreign portfolio investment had fluctuated throughout the fourth quarter of 2026 amid heightened global economic uncertainty.

“Foreign portfolio investment flows in the fourth quarter of 2026 have fluctuated due to global uncertainty and foreign investor sentiment in the stock market, resulting in equity market outflows of $900 million as of Nov. 16,” Destry told a press conference in Jakarta.

She said overall portfolio inflows were primarily driven by the government’s issuance of global sukuk, or Islamic bonds, and conventional global bonds, as well as foreign investment in domestic government securities (SBN).

Indonesia’s external sector continued to receive support from a trade surplus of $3.36 billion in September.

Meanwhile, the country’s foreign exchange reserves stood at $146.8 billion at the end of October, equivalent to five months of imports and government external debt servicing.

title: Wealthy Individuals, Big Corporations Seen as Untapped Tax Sources
article:
Jakarta. Indonesia should step up efforts to collect taxes from wealthy individuals and highly profitable corporations rather than intensify pressure on micro, small and medium enterprises (MSMEs), an economist said, warning that a more equitable tax strategy is needed to boost state revenue without further burdening lower-income groups.

Telisa Aulia Falianty, an economics professor at the University of Indonesia (UI), said the government still had room to increase personal income tax (PPh) collections from wealthy individuals and corporate income tax from companies recording substantial profits.

“We should not keep going after those at the bottom while leaving those at the top untouched,” Telisa said during a Meja Redaksi discussion hosted by B-Universe on Tuesday.

She pointed to banking deposit trends as an indication of the tax potential among wealthier Indonesians. Citing data from the Indonesia Deposit Insurance Corporation (LPS), Telisa said deposits exceeding Rp 5 billion had recorded strong growth, even as lower- and middle-income households continued to face economic pressures.

She said the government should strengthen tax compliance monitoring of high-wealth individuals, particularly through its existing profiling efforts.

“The question is how compliant the upper-income groups have been in paying their taxes. The government has said it is profiling high-wealth individuals for personal income tax purposes,” she said.

Beyond wealthy individuals, Telisa highlighted opportunities to improve corporate income tax compliance among companies benefiting from windfall profits, particularly those in the crude palm oil, coal and other commodity-related industries.

“Companies benefiting from commodity windfalls should also have their tax compliance examined,” she said.

She stressed that the government did not necessarily need to impose additional taxes on these businesses but should ensure they fulfilled their existing obligations and that opportunities for tax avoidance were addressed.

“Those who should pay more taxes and contribute more to the state are those who have benefited more and earned higher profits,” Telisa said.

Meanwhile, she cautioned the government against sending signals that it planned to expand the tax burden on MSMEs and small businesses without adequate explanation. Lower-income households were already dealing with rising essential goods prices and various financial obligations, including health insurance contributions and other levies.

“People are already facing more financial burdens, from health insurance contributions and various other fees to rising prices of basic necessities. The government needs to be mindful of that,” she said.

Telisa said tax fairness should apply across all income groups, but taxpayers' ability to pay must remain a key consideration.

Data from the Finance Ministry's November 2026 state budget (APBN KiTa) report showed that non-oil and gas income tax revenue reached Rp 893.10 trillion ($48.97 billion) as of October, up 16.6% year-on-year. Corporate income tax collections stood at Rp 303.5 trillion, increasing 28.2%.

The ministry attributed the growth in corporate income tax partly to improved profitability in the palm oil industry and lower tax refunds.

Telisa said the government should focus on improving compliance among taxpayers who had yet to fulfill their obligations rather than repeatedly pursuing those who were already compliant. She also stressed the importance of transparency in the use of state revenue to maintain public trust.

“Do not keep pursuing those who are already compliant. That is the mindset that needs to change,” she said.

title: BI Hikes Benchmark Rate to 6% in November to Support Rupiah
article:
Jakarta. Bank Indonesia (BI) raised its benchmark interest rate by 25 basis points to 6.00% on Wednesday, stepping up monetary tightening to stabilize the rupiah amid heightened global uncertainty and keep inflation within its target range.

The decision was made at the central bank's Board of Governors Meeting (RDG) on Nov. 17–18, 2026. BI also raised its Deposit Facility rate by 25 bps to 5.25% and its Lending Facility rate by the same margin to 6.75%.

BI Governor Destry Damayanti said the central bank would maintain a consistent monetary policy stance focused on strengthening stability and keeping inflation within its target range.

"The BI Board of Governors Meeting on Nov. 17–18, 2026, decided to raise the BI-Rate by 25 bps to 6.00%, the Deposit Facility rate by 25 bps to 5.25%, and the Lending Facility rate by 25 bps to 6.75%," Destry said at a press conference in Jakarta on Wednesday.

She said the rate hike was intended to reinforce rupiah stability amid rising global uncertainty, while also serving as a preemptive measure to keep inflation within the central bank's 2%–4% target range for 2026 and 2027.

BI will continue to optimize its monetary policy instruments to strengthen external resilience and maintain economic stability, Destry said.

Meanwhile, the central bank will strengthen its macroprudential policies to encourage lending and financing to the real sector while maintaining financial system stability. Its payment system policies will also remain geared toward supporting economic activity.

title: ASEAN Likely Won’t Say No to Trump’s Magnet Offer
article:
Jakarta. ASEAN Secretary-General Kao Kim Hourn signaled Wednesday that the Southeast Asian bloc was open to accepting Washington's offer to be a rare earth and magnet supplier, but the decision would hinge on the members.

US President Donald Trump recently advised ASEAN leaders to pursue magnet production and ship them to Washington, saying they could reap huge profits.

Asked about the group's response to Trump’s offer, Kao kept the doors open, while pointing to the US’s “comprehensive strategic partnership” status, which would mean the highest tier of ties.

“It’s normal that we have this expression of interest in collaboration. I don’t see that ASEAN will say no, but of course, it’s up to the ASEAN member states to work it out. Because it is in our interest to continue our policy of engagement with all of our external partners,” Kao told a briefing in Jakarta.

“I think it's something that I don't want to put the cart before the horse, but let's look at the decisions of the member states collectively.”

Kao said that ASEAN nations had agreed to “meet up more” on critical minerals.

During the dinner, Trump — the last foreign leader to touch down in Manila for the ASEAN Summit — touted how Washington had made many “vital agreements”, including on minerals.

“I hope you are going to be working very hard on critical minerals, rare earths, and magnets. If you don't mind, get magnets,” Trump said in a televised speech with President Prabowo Subianto in the room.

“Somebody at the table is going to say, ‘I’m going to listen to him’. You are going to make a lot of money. We want magnets.”

The US is heavily reliant on Chinese magnets. It has been trying to wean off Beijing’s grip on these vital components for consumer electronics and other advanced technologies.

ASEAN and the US rolled out a joint statement following Trump’s dinner.

The 15-page document has a paragraph dedicated to critical minerals. The document wrote that they would beef up “investment promotion” and explore “public-private partnerships” in this sector.

At home, the sovereign fund Danantara has unveiled Indonesia’s plans to set up a magnet production facility by 2028, with the output likely to be used for electric vehicle motors.

Under a February tariff deal, Jakarta has pledged to remove its mineral export restrictions and provide greater certainty for American businesses. It also agreed to work together on the “expedient development of its rare earth and critical minerals sector” for “secure and diversified supply chains”. The tariff agreement is still awaiting ratification before the provisions — many of which analysts find to heavily favor Washington — can enter into force.

title: Jakarta Stocks Rise as Investors Await BI Rate Decision
article:
Jakarta. Indonesian stocks opened Wednesday’s trading higher, gaining 18 points or 0.35% to 5,323 as investors awaited Bank Indonesia’s latest monetary policy decision and monitored global technology sector concerns.

Jakarta Composite Index (JCI) ranged between 5,322 and 5,349 in early trading. Trading volume reached 719.92 million shares, with a turnover of Rp 263 billion ($14.41 million) across 40,478 transactions. A total of 173 stocks advanced, 74 declined, and 163 remained unchanged.

Phintraco Sekuritas said investors were awaiting the outcome of Bank Indonesia’s Board of Governors Meeting (RDG BI), with market consensus still expecting the central bank to maintain its benchmark BI Rate at 5.75%, the Deposit Facility Rate at 5%, and the Lending Facility Rate at 6.5%.

However, economists remain divided over the decision amid continued rupiah depreciation, Phintraco Sekuritas said. The currency’s performance remains a key consideration for BI in determining its interest rate policy, alongside expectations of higher US Federal Reserve rates and domestic uncertainty.

“On the other hand, BI must also consider the momentum of domestic economic growth,” Phintraco Sekuritas said.

The brokerage also projected that credit growth would ease slightly to 13% year-on-year in October 2026, down from 13.26% in September.

Meanwhile, investors are also monitoring developments in the selection of Indonesia’s new vice president, with the inauguration scheduled for Dec. 9, 2026, Phintraco Sekuritas said.

“This could influence perceptions of political stability and the continuity of government policies,” the brokerage added.

Kiwoom Sekuritas Indonesia said global market sentiment remained largely negative amid growing concerns over the scale of investment in the artificial intelligence sector, uncertainty surrounding Nvidia’s strategy following its CEO change, and escalating technology tensions between the United States and China.

“Investors are also monitoring Anthropic’s IPO plan, which is expected to offer shares at the upper end of its valuation range or higher. In addition, the market is awaiting the FOMC meeting minutes and statements from several Fed officials for clues on the next direction of monetary policy,” Kiwoom said in its Wednesday research note.

Nvidia’s performance has become a key catalyst for the technology sector after the company reported quarterly results that exceeded market expectations.

However, US stocks came under renewed pressure on Tuesday as Nvidia and other artificial intelligence-related stocks led broad losses on Wall Street.

The S&P 500 fell 1%, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 1.6%. The Nasdaq Composite declined 0.7%.

title: Trump Touts Indonesian Tariff, Defense Deals in ASEAN Talks
article:
Jakarta. US President Donald Trump touted the Indonesian tariff and defense deals his government had bagged this year as he dined with Southeast Asian leaders on Tuesday night.

Trump is on a busy week of international diplomacy as he takes a whirlwind trip to Asia. At his first stop, the Philippines, Trump joined the ASEAN Summit, although he had only arrived near the end of the gathering.

In a dinner dubbed the “ASEAN-US Special Summit”, Trump talked of how his country had clinched some trade agreements in the region known to be “one of the busiest commercial crossroads on the planet”.

“Since I returned to office, we’ve made major trade deals with Malaysia, Cambodia, Indonesia …,” Trump said, speaking from a podium that faces the other world leaders, including President Prabowo Subianto.

The speech also took place shortly after Trump and Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul inked a joint statement on the “substantial conclusion” of their trade negotiations. He also claimed that US exports had reached an all-time high.

He then moved to speak to the “major defense cooperation partnership” with Indonesia, an April deal that includes military training and next-generation hardware co-development. The satisfied Trump even praised the ex-defense minister Prabowo for “doing a great job” with the deal.

In February 2026, Indonesia and the US clinched a reciprocal trade deal.

Trump’s attempt to slap double-digit tariffs to fix trade imbalances had pressured countries into negotiating such accords.

The Indonesian deal is still awaiting the legal procedures or ratification before it can enter into force.

However, the document allows virtually all US products to enter the Indonesian market tariff-free versus the 19% rate on Jakarta’s goods. It also binds Indonesia to heaps of concessions, including removing export restrictions on critical minerals.

Indonesia-US trade rose by around 11% year-on-year to $37 billion in the first 9 months of 2026, government statistics showed. Indonesia recorded a $14 billion surplus over the said period.

US reported that its goods trade with ASEAN totaled $579.8 billion throughout 2025. Washington’s deficit skyrocketed 44% year-on-year (yoy) to $327.4 billion.

On defense, Indonesia received 12 units of American combat vehicles in September. The Navy had bought 35 assault amphibious vehicles (AAVs) as part of a deal worth more than $23 million. This is also Indonesia's first significant foreign military sale purchase from the US in years.

title: Economist Warns Against Aggressive Year-End Tax Collection Drive
article:
Jakarta. The government's push to collect Rp 514 trillion ($28.15 billion) in taxes in the final two months of 2026 risks straining corporate liquidity, disrupting investment, and ultimately undermining economic growth if pursued too aggressively, a senior economist warned on Tuesday.

Telisa Aulia Falianty, an economics professor at the University of Indonesia, urged the government to exercise caution in meeting the annual tax revenue target.

“It is true that the target must be pursued, but the government should not be overly aggressive,” Telisa said during a podcast hosted by B-Universe Media Holdings.

She said the government should carefully assess the financial capacity of businesses and the country's overall fiscal position before intensifying tax collection efforts.

According to figures presented by Finance Minister Suahasil Nazara on Nov. 13, tax revenue reached Rp 1.797 quadrillion as of Oct. 31, up 23.2% year on year and equivalent to 76.2% of the full-year target of Rp 2.358 quadrillion.

While the shortfall against the annual target stood at Rp 560.9 trillion, the government has indicated that it needs to collect Rp 514 trillion in November and December.

Telisa argued that the 2026 tax revenue target had been overly optimistic from the outset, given that actual collections reached only around 89% of the target in 2025 and 95% in 2024.

She said revenue targets should better reflect historical collection trends and the economy's capacity to generate additional tax revenue.

“The tax revenue target of Rp 2.358 quadrillion is actually too high,” she said.

Rather than pursuing the nominal target at all costs, Telisa suggested that the government recalculate its revenue requirements for the remainder of the year based on the overall state budget position.

She estimated that additional tax revenue of around Rp 300 trillion might be more realistic, although further analysis would be needed to determine the optimal figure.

Her remarks came as the government maintained that the country's fiscal position remained manageable. As of October, state revenue totaled Rp 2.618 quadrillion, while government spending reached Rp 2.997 quadrillion.

The budget deficit stood at Rp 379.3 trillion, equivalent to 1.47% of gross domestic product (GDP).

Telisa said tax collection efforts should focus primarily on noncompliant taxpayers, highly profitable corporations, and high-income individuals rather than placing additional pressure on businesses and individuals who already meet their tax obligations.

“The government should not keep going after those who are already compliant. That is the paradigm we should adopt,” she said.

She also urged the government to address outstanding tax refund obligations to businesses, warning that delays in returning tax overpayments could further strain corporate liquidity.

Looking ahead to 2027, Telisa called for a more rigorous approach to setting tax revenue targets, incorporating historical collection data, sensitivity analysis, and tax buoyancy --- a measure of how responsive tax revenue is to economic growth.

Marak Penipuan Digital, Tokocrypto Ingatkan Konsumen Waspadai Modus Phishing
article:
Reporter:Vivit Dewi| Editor:Tri Sulistiowati

KONTAN.CO.ID - JAKARTA.Ancaman penipuan digital masih menjadi perhatian di tengah meningkatnya aktivitas masyarakat di platform online. Salah satu modus yang perlu diwaspadai adalahphishing, yakni upaya penipuan dengan menyamar sebagai pihak tepercaya untuk mencuri informasi sensitif milik korban.

Asal tahu saja, berdasarkan data IndonesiaAnti-Scam Centre(IASC) Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK), terdapat 637.055 laporan penipuan transaksi keuangan sejak lembaga tersebut mulai beroperasi pada November 2024 hingga Juli 2026.

Ancaman serupa juga terlihat dari data IndonesiaDomain Abuse Data Exchange(IDADX) yang dikelola Pengelola Nama Domain Internet Indonesia (PANDI). IDADX mencatat sebanyak 6.491 laporan phishing terkait domain .id sepanjang semester I 2026.

Melihat kondisi tersebut, platform perdagangan aset kripto Tokocrypto mengingatkan konsumen untuk mengenali sejumlah modus penipuan digital yang dapat mengancam keamanan akun dan aset mereka.

Chief Operating OfficerTokocrypto Dema Tio mengatakan, perlindungan konsumen perlu didukung oleh peningkatan literasi keamanan digital agar masyarakat mampu mengenali berbagai bentuk penipuan.

"Keamanan konsumen merupakan prioritas Tokocrypto. Kami percaya bahwa perlindungan di tingkat platform perlu diimbangi dengan literasi agar masyarakat lebih waspada dalam mengenali penipuan dan menjaga keamanan akun mereka. Karena itu, edukasi menjadi bagian dari tanggung jawab bersama dalam membangun ekosistem aset kripto yang lebih aman," ujar Dema dalam keterangannya, Rabu (18/11/2026).

Tokocrypto mengidentifikasi lima modus dan tanda penipuan digital yang perlu diwaspadai konsumen.Pertama, tautan mencurigakan yang dikirim melalui pesan dan mengarahkan pengguna ke situs palsu. Tautan semacam ini kerap dibuat menyerupai situs resmi perusahaan untuk mengelabui korban.

Kedua, penggunaan akun pengirim tidak resmi yang memiliki identitas menyerupai akun perusahaan. Konsumen diminta memastikan keaslian akun sebelum mengikuti instruksi atau memberikan informasi pribadi.

Ketiga, permintaan kata sandi maupun kode sekali pakai (one-time password/OTP). Informasi tersebut bersifat rahasia sehingga tidak boleh dibagikan kepada pihak lain, termasuk pihak yang mengaku sebagai perwakilan perusahaan.

Keempat, pihak yang mengaku sebagai layanan pelanggan melalui telepon atau WhatsApp. Tokocrypto menegaskan tidak memiliki layanan pelanggan melalui kedua saluran tersebut. Adapunkelima, email yang tidak dilengkapi kode verifikasi unik sebagai salah satu penanda keaslian komunikasi resmi perusahaan.

Ketua Umum Asosiasi Blockchain Indonesia (ABI) Robby Bun menyebut, edukasi dan kolaborasi lintas sektor penting untuk meningkatkan perlindungan konsumen dari ancaman kejahatan siber. Ia juga mengapresiasi upaya Tokocrypto dalam meningkatkan literasi keamanan digital masyarakat.

"Ancaman siber seperti phishing merupakan risiko yang dapat dihadapi siapa saja di ruang digital," kata Robby.

Selain mengedukasi konsumen, Tokocrypto juga mendorong pengguna meningkatkan perlindungan akun dengan mengaktifkan fiturpasskey. Fitur ini memungkinkan autentikasi menggunakan metode biometrik, seperti sidik jari atau pengenalan wajah, saat masuk ke akun maupun melakukan penarikan dana.

Dema bilang, penggunaanpasskeydapat memberikan perlindungan tambahan terhadap risiko phishing karena pengguna tidak hanya mengandalkan kata sandi konvensional.

"Kata sandi dapat bocor atau dicuri melalui berbagai modus penipuan. Denganpasskey, pengguna memiliki metode autentikasi yang lebih tahan terhadap phishing. Langkah sederhana ini kami harapkan dapat mulai diterapkan oleh seluruh konsumen," jelasnya.

Selainpasskey, Tokocrypto juga menerapkan sejumlah lapisan keamanan lain, seperti autentikasi dua faktor (2FA) dan verifikasi identitas atauKnow Your Customer(KYC) dengan teknologi anti-deepfakeyang terintegrasi dengan VIDA.

Di sisi transparansi aset, perusahaan menerapkanProof of Reserves(PoR) untuk memungkinkan pengguna memeriksa ketersediaan cadangan aset. Tokocrypto juga mengandalkan pemantauan transaksi dan mekanisme mitigasi risiko untuk mengantisipasi potensi kejahatan keuangan digital.

Untuk memastikan keaslian komunikasi maupun memperoleh bantuan, konsumen dapat menghubungi layananLive ChatTokocrypto yang tersedia selama 24 jam melalui aplikasi dan situs resmi perusahaan. Tokocrypto mengingatkan konsumen agar mewaspadai pihak yang mengatasnamakan perusahaan melalui WhatsApp, Telegram, maupun SMS.

title: RKAB Terbit, Garda Tujuh Buana (GTBO) Geber Produksi dan Pengapalan Batubara
article:
Reporter:Yuliana Hema| Editor:Khomarul Hidayat

KONTAN.CO.ID - JAKARTA. PT Garda Tujuh Buana Tbk (GTBO) mulai menggenjot produksi batubara setelah memperoleh persetujuan Rencana Kerja dan Anggaran Biaya (RKAB) 2026 pada September lalu.

Presiden Direktur Garda Tujuh Buana Ganesh Tikamdas Ramchandani mengatakan, Kementerian Energi dan Sumber Daya Mineral (KESDM) menyetujui RKAB GTBO melalui surat persetujuan tertanggal 25 September 2026.

Melalui RKAB tersebut, GTBO memperoleh kuota produksi batubara maksimal 817.900 ton pada 2026. Namun, GTBO memperkirakan produksi batubara hingga Desember baru mencapai 400.000–500.000 ton tahun ini.

“Hingga akhir tahun, kami seharusnya memiliki keuangan yang positif. Kami sedang bekerja keras. Seluruh tim juga sedang bekerja keras untuk mengubah perusahaan menjadi perkembangan positif,” jelasnya dalam paparan publik, Rabu (18/11/2026).

GTBO telah menyiapkan peralatan dan kontraktor untuk mengejar target produksi batubara. GTBO juga memasang Emmat pompa air untuk mengantisipasi curah hujan tinggi di Pulau Bunyu.

Cuaca menjadi salah satu tantangan operasional di Pulau Bunyu. Ganesh menyebut curah hujan tahunan di wilayah tersebut mencapai sekitar 3.000 milimeter sehingga berpotensi mengganggu aktivitas penambangan.

GTBO menargetkan pemulihan sebagian kehilangan produksi tahun ini. Ganesh menyampaikan pihaknya berupaya mencapai sedikitnya 80% dari target produksi yang sebelumnya tertunda akibat keterlambatan penerbitan RKAB.

GTBO mempercepat operasional setelah persetujuan RKAB, termasuk dimulainya kegiatan produksi dan pengapalan perdana yang berlangsung pada November tahun ini di Pulau Bunyu.

“Di sisi penjualan, GTBO memiliki tiga kontrak penjualan batubara, terdiri atas dua kontrak jangka panjang dan satu kontrak jangka pendek,” kata Ganesh.

Ganesh bilang GTBO telah memulai pengapalan perdana batubara pada 17 November 2026. Produk GTBO merupakan batubara berkalori rendah sekitar 3.000 kilokalori.

“Kami melihat peluang pasar dari permintaan batubara berkalori rendah untuk kebutuhan pencampuran atau blending. Di mana, Vietnam, Thailand, China dan India menjadi negara yang potensial,” tuturnya.

Selain pasar ekspor, GTBO akan memenuhi kewajiban domestic market obligation (DMO) sebesar 25% pada 2026. Untuk ekspor berikutnya, perseroan akan mengikuti ketentuan Danantara dan peraturan yang berlaku.

Untuk menjaga efisiensi, GTBO berencana menerapkan teknologi digital guna memantau produktivitas pekerja dan utilisasi alat berat. GTBO juga mempertimbangkan pembelian peralatan sendiri mulai tahun depan.

“Penggunaan peralatan sewaan saat ini dinilai cukup mahal. Oleh karena itu, kami mempertimbangkan pembelian bertahap dengan dukungan pembiayaan dan skema leasing untuk menekan biaya,” jelas Ganesh.

title: Wall Street: Dow Turun, S&P 500 dan Nasdaq Naik, Investor Cermati IPO Anthropic
article:
Sumber:Reuters| Editor:Khomarul Hidayat

KONTAN.CO.ID -NEW YORK. Indeks utama bursa saham Amerika Serikat (AS) atau Wall Street dibuka beragam pada Rabu (18/11/2026).

Indeks Dow Jones Industrial Average turun 132,1 poin, atau 0,26%, pada saat pembukaan ke level 50.627,36. Indeks S&P 500 naik 15,2 poin, atau 0,21%, pada saat pembukaan ke level 7.355,69.

Sementara indeks Nasdaq Composite juga naik 157,8 poin, atau 0,65%, ke level 24.486,175 saat pembukaan perdagangan, Rabu (18/11/2026).

Indeks S&P 500 dan Nasdaq yang sarat dengan saham teknologi naik setelah prakiraan pendapatan yang optimistis dari Nvidia meredakan kekhawatiran investor mengenai masa depan perusahaan pemimpin di sektor cip tersebut. Sekaligus memperbaiki sentimen terhadap saham-saham yang terkait dengan kecerdasan buatan (AI).

Nvidia memperkirakan pendapatan kuartal keempat 2026 mencapai US$ 130 miliar, dengan margin plus-minus 3%. Menurut data yang dihimpun oleh LSEG, rata-rata analis sebelumnya mengestimasi angka sebesar US$ 125,25 miliar.

Ketidakpastian mengenai prospek Nvidia—menyusul kepergian mendadak mantan CEO Jensen Huang pekan lalu—sempat mengguncang kepercayaan investor terhadap sektor AI. Pada hari Selasa, dewan direksi Nvidoa menepis gagasan untuk mempekerjakan kembali Huang, di tengah kampanye yang mendesak agar ia kembali.

"Mengingat ketidakpastian yang menyelimuti perusahaan, Nvidia sebenarnya bisa saja menarik kembali panduan kinerjanya dan menetapkan target yang lebih rendah. Namun, mereka justru menunjukkan sikap percaya diri yang penting bagi para investor maupun karyawan yang tengah merasa cemas," ujar Jay Peters, manajer portofolio di NewEdge Wealth seperti dikutipReuters.

Hasil dan komentar positif tersebut juga mengangkat saham perusahaan cip pesaing. Saham Advanced Micro Devices, Broadcom, Micron, dan Marvell masing-masing mencatatkan kenaikan antara 1,5% hingga 2%.

Setelah hasil kinerja Nvidia dirilis, perhatian kini beralih pada penetapan harga penawaran umum perdana (IPO) Anthropic yang akan berlangsung hari ini. Peristiwa ini menjadi ujian penting bagi minat Wall Street terhadap perusahaan-perusahaan yang terkait dengan lonjakan kecerdasan buatan (AI).

Pencipta chatbot Claude ini membidik valuasi hingga US$ 1,4 triliun, yang akan menjadikannya IPO pertama yang dilakukan oleh pengembang model AI mutakhir (frontier AI).

Selain itu, investor juga mencermati sinyal kebijakan moneter  The Fed.

Christopher Waller, pejabat Federal Reserve, menyatakan kepada CNBC pada hari Rabu bahwa The Fed perlu menaikkan suku bunga sebesar setengah poin persentase pada pertemuan bulan Desember, atau setidaknya memberikan sinyal mengenai respons yang lebih agresif terhadap inflasi melalui komunikasi kebijakannya.

Para investor akan menelaah risalah pertemuan Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) bulan Oktober—yang akan dirilis hari Rabu ini—untuk mencari petunjuk mengenai arah kebijakan bank sentral tersebut.

Menurut perangkat FedWatch dari CME Group, para pelaku pasar hampir sepenuhnya mengantisipasi kenaikan suku bunga sebesar 25 basis poin pada bulan depan.

Pekan lalu, sejumlah pejabat The Fed telah menyuarakan perlunya kenaikan suku bunga yang agresif menyusul laporan inflasi bulan Oktober yang lebih tinggi dari perkiraan.

title: Rupiah Bangkit Tipis dari Rekor Terlemah, Beban Subsidi APBN Masih Berat
article:
Penulis:Muhammad Alief Andri| Editor:Ignatia Maria Sri Sayekti

KONTAN.CO.ID - JAKARTA.Pelemahan nilai tukar rupiah masih menahan manfaat penurunan harga minyak mentah terhadap Anggaran Pendapatan dan Belanja Negara (APBN) 2026. Meski harga minyak mulai melandai, biaya minyak mentah dalam rupiah masih sekitar 68% di atas asumsi APBN, menurut perhitungan EBC Financial Group.

Kurs referensi Jakarta Interbank Spot Dollar Rate (JISDOR) Bank Indonesia (BI) pada Rabu (18/11/2026) berada di level Rp 18.252 per dolar AS. Rupiah menguat tipis Rp 12 atau 0,07% dibandingkan posisi sehari sebelumnya sebesar Rp 18.264 per dolar AS.

Meski menguat, posisi JISDOR pada 18 November masih berada di sekitar level terlemahnya. Rekor terendah sebelumnya tercatat pada Selasa (17/11/2026) di level Rp 18.264 per dolar AS.

Penguatan rupiah tersebut terjadi setelah BI menaikkan suku bunga acuan atau BI Rate sebesar 25 basis poin menjadi 6% pada Rabu (18/11/2026). Langkah ini ditempuh untuk menjaga stabilitas nilai tukar rupiah.

Di sisi lain, belanja subsidi dan kompensasi, termasuk untuk sektor energi dan nonenergi, telah mencapai Rp 415,8 triliun hingga Oktober 2026. Nilai tersebut meningkat 32% secara tahunan.

Analis Pasar Keuangan EBC Financial Group, Sana Ur Rehman mengatakan, penurunan harga minyak memang memberikan ruang bagi APBN. Namun, manfaatnya tidak sepenuhnya terasa karena pelemahan rupiah membuat biaya pembelian minyak dalam mata uang domestik tetap tinggi.

“Harga minyak yang lebih murah memang membantu APBN, tetapi tidak sebesar penurunan harga minyaknya. Indonesia membayar minyak dalam dolar AS, dan saat ini satu dolar membutuhkan sekitar 11% lebih banyak rupiah dibanding asumsi APBN. Harga Pertalite dan Solar bersubsidi tetap, sehingga konsumen tidak merasakan apa-apa dan Kementerian Keuangan yang menanggung selisihnya,” ujar Sana dalam keterangan resmi, Rabu (18/11/2026).

Kementerian Energi dan Sumber Daya Mineral (ESDM) memproyeksikan harga minyak mentah Indonesia atau Indonesia Crude Price (ICP) pada November 2026 berada di kisaran US$ 103,94 hingga US$ 108,94 per barel. Angka tersebut turun dibandingkan ICP Oktober yang mencapai US$ 117,24 per barel.

Meski demikian, titik tengah proyeksi ICP November sebesar US$ 106,44 per barel masih lebih dari US$ 36 di atas asumsi APBN 2026 sebesar US$ 70 per barel.

Pelemahan rupiah semakin memperlebar selisih tersebut. Kurs JISDOR pada 16 November 2026 tercatat sekitar 11% lebih lemah dibandingkan asumsi APBN sebesar Rp 16.500 per dolar AS.

Dengan kurs tersebut, minyak seharga US$ 106,44 per barel setara sekitar Rp 1,94 juta. Nilai ini jauh lebih tinggi dibandingkan sekitar Rp 1,155 juta per barel berdasarkan asumsi harga minyak dan kurs dalam APBN.

EBC menjelaskan, perhitungan tersebut membandingkan proyeksi harga minyak untuk satu bulan dengan asumsi APBN setahun penuh. Karena itu, angka tersebut menggambarkan skala tekanan, bukan nilai akhir tagihan pemerintah.

Kontribusi pelemahan rupiah terhadap selisih biaya minyak juga semakin besar. Berdasarkan rata-rata sejak awal tahun, pelemahan rupiah menyumbang sekitar 6 poin persentase dari selisih biaya sebesar 43%. Namun, dengan menggunakan kurs 16 November, porsinya meningkat menjadi sekitar seperlima dari selisih biaya sebesar 68%.

Tekanan terhadap APBN juga terlihat dari selisih antara harga jual BBM bersubsidi dan harga keekonomiannya. Pertalite dijual Rp 10.000 per liter, sedangkan harga keekonomiannya mencapai Rp 18.102 per liter. Adapun Solar dijual Rp 6.800 per liter, jauh di bawah harga keekonomian sebesar Rp 21.457 per liter.

Selisih tersebut menjadi beban pemerintah melalui subsidi dan kompensasi. Pelemahan rupiah turut memperlebar kesenjangan biaya, dengan Solar menanggung selisih terbesar per liter.

Di sisi volume, penyaluran BBM bersubsidi meningkat 9,5% menjadi 15,24 juta kiloliter hingga Oktober 2026. Kenaikan harga BBM nonsubsidi mendorong sebagian konsumen beralih ke BBM bersubsidi sehingga ikut meningkatkan penyalurannya.

Realisasi belanja hingga Oktober juga dipengaruhi perubahan jadwal pembayaran kompensasi kepada PT Pertamina dan PT PLN. Pembayaran yang sebelumnya dilakukan setiap tiga bulan kini berubah menjadi bulanan.

Selain harga minyak dan nilai tukar, biaya pembiayaan pemerintah turut menghadapi tekanan. Imbal hasil atau yield Surat Berharga Negara (SBN) tenor 10 tahun tercatat sebesar 7,68% pada 13 November 2026, lebih tinggi dibandingkan asumsi APBN 2026 sebesar 6,9%.

Dengan demikian, harga minyak, nilai tukar rupiah, dan imbal hasil obligasi sama-sama berada di atas asumsi APBN. Penurunan harga minyak mulai memberikan ruang penghematan, tetapi pelemahan rupiah menahan manfaat tersebut, sementara kenaikan imbal hasil SBN menambah tekanan terhadap pembiayaan pemerintah.

Sana menambahkan, kebutuhan dolar AS untuk membayar impor BBM masih dapat menjadi sumber tekanan terhadap rupiah meskipun harga minyak turun.

“Importir BBM tetap membutuhkan dolar untuk membayar minyak, dan permintaan itu dapat terus menekan rupiah meski harga minyak turun,” kata Sana.

Menurut dia, stabilisasi rupiah menjadi salah satu faktor penting agar penghematan dari penurunan harga minyak dapat lebih terasa dalam APBN. Selain perkembangan harga minyak resmi berikutnya, tren belanja subsidi pemerintah dan pergerakan rupiah setelah kenaikan BI Rate juga perlu dicermati.

title: BRIDS Gandeng Pinnacle Investment, Perluas Akses Investor ke Beragam Produk Reksadana
article:
Reporter:Vivit Dewi| Editor:Ignatia Maria Sri Sayekti

KONTAN.CO.ID - JAKARTA.PT BRI Danareksa Sekuritas (BRIDS) memperluas pilihan produk investasi bagi nasabahnya melalui kemitraan strategis dengan PT Pinnacle Persada Investama (Pinnacle Investment). Kerja sama ini memungkinkan investor mengakses berbagai produk reksadana Pinnacle melalui aplikasi BRIGHTS.

Kemitraan tersebut ditandai dengan penandatanganan perjanjian antara Plt Direktur Utama BRIDS Fifi Virgantria dan CEO Pinnacle Investment Guntur S. Putra dalam acara Signing & Launching Ceremony di Auditorium Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI), Jakarta, Rabu (18/11/2026).

Bagi Pinnacle, kerja sama ini menjadi langkah untuk memperluas jangkauan distribusi sekaligus membuka akses produknya kepada lebih banyak investor ritel. Guntur bilang, jaringan distribusi BRIDS menjadi salah satu kekuatan yang dapat mendukung upaya tersebut.

“Kami menyambut baik kemitraan strategis dengan BRI Danareksa Sekuritas (BRIDS), salah satu institusi keuangan terkemuka dengan reputasi dan jaringan distribusi yang kuat di pasar modal Indonesia. Kolaborasi ini merupakan bagian dari visi kami untuk memperluas akses masyarakat terhadap solusi investasi yang inovatif, berkualitas, dan relevan dengan dinamika pasar keuangan yang terus berkembang,” ujar Guntur dalam acara Signing & Launching Ceremony di Bursa Efek Indonesia, Rabu (18/11/2026).

Asal tahu saja, Pinnacle Investment merupakan perusahaan manajemen investasi berbasis teknologi yang berdiri sejak 2014. Dengan dana kelolaan lebih dari Rp 3 triliun, perusahaan ini menawarkan sejumlah produk investasi, mulai dari reksadana saham, pendapatan tetap, pasar uang,exchange-traded fund(ETF), hingga pengelolaan portofolio secara discretionary.

Masuknya produk Pinnacle ke BRIGHTS diharapkan dapat memperkaya alternatif investasi yang tersedia bagi nasabah. Plt Direktur Utama BRIDS Fifi Virgantria mengatakan, bertambahnya jumlah investor pasar modal perlu diimbangi dengan ketersediaan produk yang sesuai dengan tujuan investasi dan profil risiko masing-masing.

“Pertumbuhan jumlah investor dalam beberapa tahun terakhir menunjukkan minat masyarakat untuk berinvestasi semakin besar. Tantangan berikutnya adalah memastikan setiap investor dapat menemukan produk yang sesuai dengan tujuan dan profil risikonya. Kami berharap kehadiran produk Pinnacle Investment di BRIGHTS dapat menambah pilihan tersebut,” kata Fifi.

Selain itu, peluang pengembangan layanan investasi tersebut juga didukung oleh pertumbuhan basis investor pasar modal domestik. Data Kustodian Sentral Efek Indonesia (KSEI) mencatat jumlah investor pasar modal Indonesia mencapai 32,17 jutasingle investor identification(SID) per akhir September 2026, tumbuh 57,96% sejak awal tahun.

Meski pertumbuhan investor cukup pesat, tingkat inklusi pasar modal masih relatif rendah. Survei Nasional Literasi dan Inklusi Keuangan (SNLIK) 2025 mencatat indeks inklusi pasar modal baru mencapai 1,34%. Kondisi ini menunjukkan masih terbukanya ruang bagi pelaku industri untuk memperluas akses masyarakat terhadap produk investasi.

Di sisi lain, kemudahan akses investasi juga perlu diimbangi dengan pemahaman terhadap risiko pasar. Dalam sesi market outlook dan product update pada acara tersebut,Head of Investment Research and AdvisoryPinnacle Investment Indra Muharam Firmansyah mengingatkan bahwa pasar masih berpotensi mengalami gejolak hingga akhir 2026 dan pertengahan 2027.

Menurut Indra, isu MSCI serta perkembangan outlook dan peringkat kredit Indonesia menjadi sejumlah faktor yang perlu dicermati investor karena berpotensi memengaruhi pergerakan pasar saham maupun obligasi.

“Hingga akhir 2026 dan pertengahan 2027, kami melihat pasar masih akan diwarnai turbulensi yang berpotensi meningkatkan volatilitas. Isu MSCI diperkirakan tetap menjadi sentimen negatif hingga keputusan akhir MSCI pada 2027. Di pasar obligasi, outlook dan peringkat dari berbagai lembaga pemeringkat juga perlu dicermati karena akan memengaruhi pergerakan pasar obligasi Indonesia,” ujar Indra.

Menghadapi kondisi pasar tersebut, Indra menyarankan investor untuk sementara lebih mengutamakan instrumen dengan risiko relatif lebih rendah, salah satunya reksadana pasar uang.

“Rekomendasi kita tetap, untuk saat ini, lebih baik investasi ke reksadana pasar uang dulu,” katanya.

Adapun bagi investor yang tetap ingin berinvestasi di pasar saham, Indra menyarankan untuk mencermati emiten dengan fundamental kuat, berorientasi jangka panjang, serta memiliki potensi pembagian dividen. Diversifikasi dan pengelolaan risiko juga perlu menjadi pertimbangan dalam menyusun portofolio investasi.

title: Pinnacle Investment Bidik Pertumbuhan AUM Double Digit pada 2027
article:
Reporter:Secillia Hafifah| Editor:Tri Sulistiowati

KONTAN.CO.ID - JAKARTA.PT Pinnacle Persada Investama atau Pinnacle Investment mencatatkan total dana kelolaan atauAsset Under Management (AUM) sebesar Rp 3,25 triliun per akhir Oktober 2026. Capaian tersebut mencakup dana kelolaan Kontrak Pengelolaan Dana (KPD) dan tumbuh hampir dua digit secarayear to date(ytd).

President Directordan CEO PT Pinnacle Persada Investama Guntur Putra mengatakan, perusahaan optimistis dana kelolaan masih dapat bertumbuh hingga akhir tahun ini. Dengan sisa waktu sekitar satu setengah bulan, Pinnacle Investment memperkirakan AUM berada tidak jauh dari Rp 3,5 triliun.

"Year to datekita cukup ada perkembangan. AUM kita cukup positif,growthkita juga hampir double digit. Total dana kelolaan kita ada Rp 3,25 triliun yang masuk ke KPD per akhir Oktober 2026," ujar Guntur.

Untuk 2027, Pinnacle Investment berharap dapat mencatatkan pertumbuhan dana kelolaan dua digit. Guntur mengatakan, perusahaan tidak menetapkan target AUM secara khusus. Menurutnya, pertumbuhan dana kelolaan akan mengikuti kualitas pengelolaan investasi dan kepercayaan investor.

"Kalau misalnya kita berinvestasi dengan baik dan transparansi kepada investor, otomatis dana kelolaan juga akan bertumbuh dengan sendirinya," katanya.

Salah satu strategi yang disiapkan untuk mendorong pertumbuhan AUM pada tahun depan adalah memperluas basis investor, terutama melalui penguatan jaringan distribusi di segmen ritel. Sepanjang tahun ini, Pinnacle Investment telah menambah lima agen penjual reksadana.

Guntur menyebut, perusahaan juga menjalin kerja sama dengan sejumlah mitra distribusi untuk memperluas jangkauan investor. Upaya tersebut akan kembali dilanjutkan pada 2027.

Dari sisi investasi, Guntur mengatakan, eksposur pasar saham memberikan pengaruh terhadap portofolio perusahaan, terutama pada pengelolaan KPD yang sebagian besar investornya berasal dari global. Sementara itu, instrumen pasar uang juga masih menarik minat investor karena menawarkan likuiditas yang tinggi.

Saat ini, dana kelolaan KPD Pinnacle Investment mencapai sekitar Rp 400 miliar. Guntur menambahkan, instrumen pasar uang masih diminati investor yang memilih untuk menahan dana tunai sembari mencermati perkembangan kondisi pasar ke depan.

"Cash is king.Ada investor yang lebih memilih memegang cash terlebih dahulu untuk melihat situasi dan kondisi berikutnya," katanya.

title: Ajaib Kripto Hadirkan Perdagangan Tokenized Stock Global Berbasis Rupiah
article:
Reporter:Vivit Dewi| Editor:Khomarul Hidayat

KONTAN.CO.ID - JAKARTA.Ajaib Kripto meluncurkan kontrak perpetual berbasis tokenized stock yang mengacu pada sejumlah perusahaan global, mulai dari SpaceX, NVIDIA, hingga Tesla. Kontrak tersebut tersedia dalam pilihan pasangan perdagangan berbasis rupiah maupun USDT.

Produk bernama Tokenized Stock Perpetual ini mulai diperdagangkan pada Rabu (18/11/2026) melalui menu Futures di aplikasi Ajaib Kripto. Terdapat sembilan pasangan kontrak yang dapat diperdagangkan dengan posisi long maupun short.

Kesembilan kontrak tersebut mencakup SpaceX (SPCXX-PERP), NVIDIA (NVDAX-PERP), Tesla (TSLAX-PERP), Apple (AAPLX-PERP), Alphabet atau Google (GOOGLX-PERP), Amazon (AMZNX-PERP), Meta Platforms (METAX-PERP), Strategy (MSTRX-PERP), dan Circle (CRCLX-PERP).

Seluruh kontrak menggunakan token xStocks dari masing-masing perusahaan sebagai acuan. Meski mengikuti pergerakan harga saham perusahaan terkait, tokenized stock tersebut tidak memberikan hak kepemilikan saham, hak suara, maupun hak atas dividen.

CEO Ajaib Kripto Adrian Sudirgo mengatakan, peluncuran produk tersebut menjadi bagian dari upaya perusahaan memperluas akses trader Indonesia terhadap pasar global tanpa harus menggunakan platform berbeda.

"Kami ingin trader Indonesia memiliki akses yang setara ke pasar global. Tokenized Stock Perpetual adalah langkah berikutnya dalam misi Ajaib untuk membangun ekosistem investasi yang lengkap dan mudah dijangkau, tempat pengguna dapat bergerak dari aset kripto hingga nama-nama yang paling banyak diburu trader global seperti SpaceX dan NVIDIA, tanpa harus berpindah platform," ujar Adrian dalam keterangannya, Rabu (18/11/2026).

Dari sisi fleksibilitas, kontrak perpetual tersebut dapat diperdagangkan selama 24 jam setiap hari, termasuk akhir pekan dan hari libur. Pengguna juga dapat memilih pasangan perdagangan berbasis rupiah maupun USDT.

Dengan tambahan sembilan pair tersebut, total kontrak perpetual yang tersedia di Ajaib Futures kini mencapai 58 pair. Jumlah ini melengkapi lebih dari 740 aset kripto yang sebelumnya telah tersedia di Ajaib Kripto.

Adrian bilang, perkembangan tokenisasi turut membuka peluang diversifikasi instrumen di industri aset digital. Hal ini juga tercermin dari pertumbuhan pasar tokenized stock secara global.

"Kami melihat kebutuhan pengguna Indonesia akan instrumen yang semakin beragam, dan Ajaib Kripto ingin menjawabnya melalui jalur yang teregulasi di dalam negeri," tambah Adrian.

Asal tahu saja, berdasarkan data rwa.xyz, nilai tokenized stock global mencapai US$ 3,73 miliar dengan 4,86 juta pemegang per 16 November 2026. Sementara itu, xStocks, penerbit tokenized stock yang kini menjadi bagian dari grup Kraken, telah mencatatkan volume transaksi kumulatif lebih dari US$ 25 miliar dalam waktu kurang dari delapan bulan sejak diluncurkan.

Di dalam negeri, aktivitas perdagangan aset kripto dan derivatif aset keuangan digital juga menunjukkan perkembangan. Otoritas Jasa Keuangan (OJK) mencatat jumlah konsumen aset kripto mencapai 23,51 juta akun per September 2026. Sementara itu, nilai transaksi derivatif aset keuangan digital pada periode yang sama mencapai Rp 5,80 triliun, meningkat dari Rp 4,56 triliun pada Agustus 2026.

Untuk operasionalnya, Tokenized Stock Perpetual masuk dalam kategori derivatif aset keuangan digital yang mengacu pada POJK Nomor 27 Tahun 2024 dan perubahan melalui POJK Nomor 23 Tahun 2025.
